q1.question: Is DocAgora free for patients?
q1.answer: Yes, creating an account, searching for professionals and booking appointments is completely free. You only pay your healthcare provider directly, as you would normally.

q2.question: Are the professionals verified?
q2.answer: Every healthcare professional on DocAgora is reviewed and approved by our team before going live. We verify their credentials, registration number and professional standing.

q3.question: What languages is DocAgora available in?
q3.answer: The platform is available in Portuguese, French and English. You can also filter professionals by the languages they speak during consultations.

q4.question: How do I book an appointment?
q4.answer: Search for a professional by specialty, city or language. Compare profiles, reviews and availability. Choose a time slot and confirm your booking in one click. You'll receive an email confirmation instantly.

q5.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
q5.answer: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule from your patient account at any time. We recommend doing so at least 24 hours before your appointment out of respect for the professional's time.

q6.question: Is my personal data safe?
q6.answer: DocAgora is fully GDPR-compliant. Your personal data is hosted on servers in Portugal and is never shared with third parties without your explicit consent. We take your privacy seriously.

q7.question: Which cities are covered?
q7.answer: DocAgora is available across major Portuguese cities including Lisbon, Porto, Coimbra, Braga, Faro and Cascais. We are continuously expanding our network of professionals.

q8.question: Do I need to create an account?
q8.answer: You can browse professionals and their availability without an account. However, you'll need to create a free account to book appointments and receive reminders.

q9.question: How do I contact support?
q9.answer: You can reach our team at hello@docagora.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours. Searching verified professionals is free; online booking is on the way.

q10.question: Can I filter professionals by insurance?
q10.answer: Yes, you can filter professionals by the health insurance plans they accept. This helps you find in-network providers and avoid unexpected costs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At DocAgora, protecting your data is a priority. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how we protect it, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect only the data needed to run the service: account information (name, email, language) and search criteria. No medical data is stored without your explicit consent.

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data is used to connect you with healthcare professionals, manage your appointments and improve the service. We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: Hosting and security
sections.body: All data is hosted on servers located in Portugal and encrypted. Access is strictly limited to authorised staff.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR, you can access, rectify, delete or request portability of your data at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms set out the rules for using the DocAgora platform. By using the service, you accept them.

sections.title: Purpose of the service
sections.body: DocAgora is a platform that connects patients with healthcare professionals in Portugal. We do not provide care and do not replace a medical consultation.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: You agree to provide accurate information and to use the platform in compliance with the law and other users.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: Listed professionals are responsible for the care they provide. DocAgora facilitates the connection but does not intervene in the care relationship.

sections.title: Changes to the service
sections.body: DocAgora may evolve its features and these terms. Significant changes will be communicated to you.

notice.title: Legal Notice
notice.intro: Legal information about the publisher of the DocAgora platform.

sections.title: Publisher
sections.body: The DocAgora platform is published by the DocAgora team. For any request, write to us at hello@docagora.com.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.body: The site and its data are hosted on infrastructure located in Portugal.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All content (text, logos, graphic elements) is protected. Any reproduction without authorisation is prohibited.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any legal question, contact us via our contact form or by email.
